agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Scale and breadth of technological significance

analytical_question: Is the technology incremental, breakthrough or potentially Promethean, and how much should that influence this application decision?
general_et_finding: Potential Promethean, prospective and qualified, following the Chapter 11 calibration (S0); not Confirmed. System: deployed generative text systems, not an isolated model component. Barrier statement: producing new fluent text or working analyses generally required human cognitive effort; this tied scalable cognitive production to available human attention. AI generation may loosen that coupling, but reliable work still needs checking, so dissolution is conditional rather than universal. Suppression test: the supplied evidence does not establish collapse of mature societal infrastructure if these systems disappeared; a retailer could return to manual drafting. That local reversion cannot alone settle the broad technology classification. Tiers: economic production and cognitive/social access are plausible affected tiers, not two empirically confirmed dissolutions. Conditional six-criterion assessment: Order of magnitude - Not established by this empirical snapshot; S1 task gains do not prove a tenfold change. Widespread impact - Provisional, S2 models occupational exposure rather than observed multi-tier transformation. Paradigm shift - Provisional, generation challenges human-only production but still requires oversight. Catalytic effect - Provisional, S2 identifies complementary software as a pathway rather than documenting a mature innovation cascade. Democratizing effect - Provisional, S1 shows heterogeneous assistance benefits, not universal access. Irreversibility - Not established. Critical mass and converging skills, data, infrastructure and institutions are not demonstrated here. The course author rates the first five criteria more strongly; this independent evidence snapshot supports a more cautious conditional assessment. Moderate confidence in the usefulness of the course classification, low confidence in realized civilizational transformation over 10-20 years. Without accepting S0 as a provisional calibration, withhold the higher label pending independent barrier and tier evidence; at most a breakthrough hypothesis is supported.
application_finding: Autonomous clinical recommendations could deeply change a high-consequence workflow, but neither S1 nor S2 establishes clinical safety or effectiveness.
organization_specific_finding: The hospital lacks local validation and monitoring capacity. Irreversible harm and missing safety evidence warrant deferral of the proposed autonomous workflow regardless of broader potential.

evidence.claim: Chapter 11 supplies the classification instrument and calibrates generative AI as Potential Promethean while leaving mature irreversibility unresolved.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0: Andres Fortino, Chapter11_Identifying_Promethean_Technologies_v0.1_WITH_FIGURES(1).docx, August 2026 Rev 0.1, sections 11.2, 11.3, 11.7
evidence.date_or_recency: Student-provided classroom reading; full extracted text read 2026-10-19
evidence.evidence_type: Assigned course framework and author interpretation
evidence.notes: Framework source, not independent empirical verification; not redistributed in this public repository.

evidence.claim: A field study reports heterogeneous customer-support productivity gains with AI assistance.
evidence.source_or_reference: Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, Generative AI at Work, https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.11771v2
evidence.notes: One deployment, not universal ROI; used qualitatively because earlier and revised versions differ.

evidence.claim: Task-exposure analysis indicates a pathway to effects across occupations and a role for complementary software.
evidence.source_or_reference: Eloundou et al., GPTs are GPTs, https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.10130v5
evidence.notes: Exposure is not realized adoption or durable societal transformation; authors do not forecast adoption timing.

evidence.claim: Generative AI can produce erroneous content and create overreliance and privacy risks.
evidence.notes: Sections 2.2, 2.4 and 2.7; risk taxonomy, not evidence of clinical efficacy or binding approval.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: S1 is one customer-support setting with heterogeneous gains; transfer and net local benefit are unproven.
S2 is modeled task exposure, not demonstrated structural change, adoption timing or job displacement.
S3 identifies reliability and governance problems; durable benefits depend on complements and controls.
The suppression test does not yet establish mature dependency or irreversible multi-tier dissolution; the higher classification is conditional on the course calibration.
S1 compares assisted support with the existing workflow; it is not a tenfold benchmark or a head-to-head test against optimized templates.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence that Potential Promethean is a useful prospective course classification, low confidence that durable multi-tier dissolution is already realized. Evidence grades remain provisional or not established. Local ROI is unmeasured. Organizational posture does not change this uncertainty.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential access benefits are hypothetical; they require application-specific clinical evidence and cannot be inferred from customer-support results.
risk_governance_implication: Require qualified clinical and institutional review, application-specific validation and a defensible safety case; this specialist supplies no clinical or legal authorization.
recommendation_management_implication: Defer the proposed autonomous clinical deployment. Consider only separately governed offline research if institutional reviewers approve it.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reconsider only after appropriate reviewers assess application-specific validation, oversight and monitoring capacity.
New general AI capabilities alone do not remove the local evidence requirement.
Reassess six criteria when independently measured access/cost gains, multi-tier adoption, dependent innovations and suppression/dependency evidence become available.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Abstain from any clinical safety, efficacy or compliance judgment.
Need application-specific evaluation, accountable clinical oversight and a verified safety case before reconsideration.
Withhold an independently established Promethean finding until barrier dissolution, at least two tiers and infrastructure dependency are supported; never upgrade this emerging case to Confirmed.
